chemical-dosing-tank-bunded-50l.shortDescription: 50L round polyethylene chemical dosing tank for water treatment and chemical dosing. 50L Chemical Bund available separately.
chemical-dosing-tank-bunded-50l.description:
A **50L round polyethylene chemical dosing tank** for water-treatment and chemical-dosing installations. The tank is sold separately so you can choose whether secondary containment is required for your installation.

Manufactured from rotationally moulded linear low-density polyethylene (PE), the tank has a seamless body suited to compatible chemical storage, mixing and dosing applications.

A **50L Chemical Bund** is available separately.

- 50L capacity
- 390 mm diameter × 460 mm overall height
- 150 mm top port
- Rotationally moulded PE construction
- Suitable for water-treatment and compatible chemical-dosing applications
features: Rotationally moulded PE construction with seamless body
Suitable for water-treatment and chemical-dosing applications
recommendedFor: pH correction and compatible liquid chemical dosing

compliance.note: Chemical dosing vessel - WaterMark does not apply. Confirm chemical compatibility and site-specific containment requirements for your installation.
